import subprocess, pathlib, zipfile, os, json

for p in sorted((root/'rust-reference/test-files').glob('*.zip')):
 z=zipfile.ZipFile(p)
 print(p.name, [(i.filename,i.flag_bits,i.compress_type,i.extra.hex()) for i in z.infolist()])
print('PROBES')
zip1=str((root/'rust-reference/test-files/1.test.txt.zip').resolve())
cases=[[],['--version'],['-h'],['--help'],['-i','missing.zip'],['-i',zip1,'-p','missing.txt'],['-i',zip1,'--workers','0'],['-i',zip1,'--minPasswordLen','0'],['-i',zip1,'--charset','x'],['-i',zip1,'--mask','?z'],['--bogus']]
for a in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([bin,*a],capture_output=True)
 print(json.dumps(a), 'code',r.returncode)
 print('OUT',repr(r.stdout.decode(errors='replace')))
 print('ERR',repr(r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')))
'@ | python -"
